title: Windows repair requires Node and does not verify Agent Chat round-trip
original_report: Elvira's Windows repair must install Node.js if it is absent, send one test message to @ardanila, and finish only after confirming the matching reply.
discovery_scope: Agent Chat direct conversation CLI contract
expected: The repair installs official Node.js LTS when needed, preserves Agent Chat data and Inbox routing, sends one nonce-bearing message to @ardanila, and confirms a reply from that exact profile with the same nonce.
actual: The previous repair stopped when Node.js was absent and declared success after local service checks without testing message delivery or a reply.
environment: Windows target; deterministic script-contract regression run on macOS because no reachable Windows runner was available.
reproduction: A focused test inspects the public Windows repair and requires the winget Node.js LTS installation plus find, open, send, read, and mark-read commands for the exact @ardanila conversation.
failure_signal: The focused test exits 1 because the previous script contains neither the winget Node.js installation nor the Agent Chat round-trip.
root_cause: The repair treated Node.js as a prerequisite and ended after local health checks; it had no end-to-end communication acceptance check.
fix_summary: Install official Node.js LTS through winget when missing, then use the installed hchat binary to open the exact @ardanila profile, send one nonce-bearing test message, wait at most five minutes for the matching reply, and mark it read.
why_causal: The changed script now supplies its missing runtime prerequisite and makes the requested remote round-trip the condition for success.

fix_files.summary: Node.js bootstrap and bounded Agent Chat round-trip.

checks.name: Focused regression
checks.detail: The same command changed from exit 1 to exit 0.

limitations: No reachable Windows runner was available; the actual delivery and reply can be proven only when Elvira runs the public script.
residual_risks: winget may request Windows elevation; if the newly installed node.exe is not visible until a new PowerShell opens, the script stops before changing Hub or Agent Chat.
notes: No dependency was added. The test sends only one message and refuses a blind retry when delivery outcome is unknown.
